test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**

The government is bringing a new law where every municipial will have its own hospitals across the country.
solution: The correct answer is **"Municipial."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Municipal"** with only one **"i."** • The word refers to a local governing body or the administration of a city or town. (ऐसे नगर या टाउन से संबंधित जहाँ स्‍थानीय स्‍वशासन हो, नगरीय, नगरपालिका-संबंधी; इसका संचालन करनेवाला अधिकारी समूह) • **Example**: *She visited the **municipal__** building.* • The incorrect spelling in the given statement is a common mistake due to the similar sounding word **"municipality."** • The correct sentence would be *"The government is bringing a new law where every __**municipal**__ will have its own hospitals across the country."* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Hospitals: **a place where ill or injured people are treated. (अस्‍पताल, चिकित्‍सालय) • **Government: **the group of people who rule or control a country. (सरकार, शासन) • **Country: **an area of land with its own people, government, etc. (किसी भूक्षेत्र में रहनेवाले लोग, उनकी सरकार आदि, देश) 3e:Ta4d, The correct answer is **"A, C, B, D."**
